description: Schedule one installation check-in email for 1–72 hours from now, only after the user explicitly requests or agrees to that email. Delivery is to the connected account's verified email address. Scheduling authorizes that email, not publication of future feedback. An email already being sent or delivered cannot be recalled. Each report allows one check-in: retrying while pending returns the existing schedule without changing it; a sent or cancelled check-in cannot be scheduled again and returns followup_exists.
name: schedule_installation_followup
title: Schedule an optional co.build check-in email
